shared_elements: avian or bird-like forms in profile
multiple motifs arranged on a vertical surface
justification: The most specific overlap is the presence of avian imagery rendered in profile with linear feather or wing detail: A has a large winged bird-headed/hybrid standing figure, while B includes profile bird-like animals among other signs. The major difference is that A is a coherent scene of a single large winged anthropomorphic figure facing a stylized tree and holding objects, whereas B is a stacked assemblage of separate animals and abstract signs with no comparable figure-tree relationship.
